chunks.content:
## Catalog Description

Research. Credit 1 or more each semester. Research in industrial engineering field; content and credit dependent upon needs of individual student.

## Course Learning Outcomes

Upon completion of this course, the learner will be able to:

- Engage in research in industrial and systems engineering.

## Special Course Designation

None

## Textbook and/or Resource Materials

This material Is: No required textbook

No Textbook Needed

## Grading Policy

Grading will be based on the following components depending on the stage of research:

- Weekly participation in meetings: 10%

- Development of literature summary: 20%

- Design of experiment/data collection/data analysis: 50%

- Manuscript writing/revision: 20%

## Late Work Policy

Work submitted by a student as makeup work for an excused absence is not considered late work and is exempt from the late work policy (Student Rule 7).

## Course Schedule

Weekly one-on-one scheduled meetings at the convenience of the student and instructor.
